points: Paralegals told AI enriches their job used it 58% more
They also experimented with it 70% more
Based on 184 interviews at three firms and a two-year law firm study
read: Full article on the research; peer-review status not stated
take: How managers introduce AI changes uptake. Leaders should explain how it improves the job, give time to explore, and stop measuring volume.
title: Stanford HAI: pitch AI as job enrichment, not productivity
